7. 
(1) A person’s income from an investment for a year
of assessment shall be the person’s gains and profits from
that investment for the year.
(2)  In  calculating  a  person’s  gains  and  profits  from  an
investment derived or received during a year of assessment
the following shall be included:-

(a)
dividends,  interest,  discounts,  charges,  annuities,
natural  resource  payments,  rents,  premiums  and
royalties;

(b)
gains from the realisation of investment assets as
calculated under Chapter IV;

(c)
amounts  derived  as  consideration  for  accepting  a

restriction  on
